cached_path_download_and_cache: download a file from a URL or S3 path and cache it locally, returning the cached file path
url_to_filename_hash_url: convert a URL into a repeatable SHA256 hashed filename with optional ETag appended
filename_to_url_resolve_cached: resolve a cached filename back to its original URL and ETag from metadata
read_set_from_file_extract_lines: read a text file line by line and return a deduplicated set of stripped lines
split_s3_path_parse_bucket: split an S3 URL into its bucket name and object path components
